verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community report of a Stripe PM confirming that multi-currency subscriptions work by creating a separate plan per currency (e.g. bronze_plan:eur). That gives per-currency price points, but only through a duplicate-plan workaround and with no first-party documentation. The analytics and revenue-recognition docs never mention currency conversion or home-currency consolidation. Missing for 10: first-party docs on local-currency billing and per-currency prices on a single plan, consolidated reporting in home currency, FX conversion handling in reports, and hands-on corroboration.
